name: text-select
title: Text Select
description: A line that writes itself a word at a time — each one arriving in the accent and cooling to the foreground a beat later, so exactly one word is ever coloured — then pushes forward to full size on a baseline-pivoted scale and gets selected, the drag sweeping across under a gradient sheen with a hard caret edge.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/text-select?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
